ns2:course.label: Disciplinary Seminar
ns2:course.description: Discussions of current research, literature and careers pertaining to disciplinary specializations within the Division of Nutritional Sciences. 0 to 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or different terms, to a maximum of 2 hours for Masters students and 4 hours for PhD students.
